title: Custom eggless cakes for Box Hill and Vineyard families — order before work
summary:
Riverstone opens at 6am on weekdays. That's not an accident — it means Box Hill and Vineyard parents can pick up a cake before the school run instead of after it.

Every cake we bake is 100% eggless — not some cakes, every cake. Six sizes, 15 flavours including Rasmalai and Ferrero Rocher, any design from a photo reference. Buttercream, fondant, or ganache.

48 hours minimum notice. That's what fresh baking actually takes. Free parking at the shopping centre, five minutes from Rouse Hill.

Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725.
